strings.name: Guillaume Faury
strings.summary: Faury began in military-helicopter flight testing and held research and management posts at Eurocopter and Peugeot. He returned to aviation to lead Airbus Helicopters in 2013 and became Airbus CEO in 2019, confronting the pandemic, supply constraints and production challenges. He promotes industrial development and lower-carbon aviation technology and was reappointed CEO in 2025.
